backward_compat_traps.trap: Putting user-facing register number directly into PDU reads one register too far. PDU_address = user_number - 1.
FC 0x05 rejects any other value with exception 0x03.

backward_compat_traps.on_wire_order: Low byte first, then high byte.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Many debuggers check the wrong CRC byte order. CRC is little-endian on the wire while data is big-endian.
Ignoring MSB of response FC causes mis-parsing an exception as a normal response.
Non-zero Protocol ID is reserved for future use; non-MODBUS payloads silently invalid.
These FCs are not supported on Modbus TCP per spec.
Implementing them breaks future MODBUS compliance; use User-Defined ranges 65..72 or 100..110 instead.

lineage.summary: Originally invented by Modicon for its PLC family. Defined the serial RTU and ASCII framings, the four data tables, and the core function-code set.
Modicon-proprietary high-speed HDLC token-passing peer-to-peer network. Deprecated in favor of Modbus TCP.
Schneider Electric publishes the Open Modbus Specification. Reserved TCP port 502.
Schneider transfers stewardship of MODBUS to Modbus.org.
First Modbus.org release. Added Encapsulated Interface Transport (FC 0x2B) with MEI 13 (CANopen) and 14 (Read Device Identification).
Errata release; clarified Read Device Identification.
Current stable release; editorial cleanups; no new function codes.
